1: /* pickups.js — itens coletáveis (health/armor/ammo/weapon) como meshes 3D.
2:  * Criação com formas e cores distintas por categoria, bobbing + rotação no update,
3:  * detecção de coleta por distância horizontal (o chamador decide áudio/efeito via onPickup).
4:  * Dependência mínima: apenas THREE; o mapa entra via parâmetro.
5:  */
6: import * as THREE from 'three';
7: 
8: const BASE_Y = 0.5;
9: const SPIN_SPEED = 2.0;
10: const BOB_SPEED = 2.2;
11: const BOB_AMPLITUDE = 0.12;
12: 
13: // Fase determinística de bobbing por índice (desync sem Math.random).
14: function phaseFor(i) {
15:   const x = Math.sin(i * 127.1 + 311.7) * 43758.5453;
16:   return (x - Math.floor(x)) * Math.PI * 2;
17: }
18: 
19: // Tempo acumulado por pickup (bobbing) — mantido fora do objeto retornado.
20: const times = new WeakMap();
21: 
22: function categoryOf(type) {
23:   if (type === 'health') return 'health';
24:   if (type === 'armor') return 'armor';
25:   if (type === 'shotgun' || type === 'chaingun' || type === 'rocket') return 'weapon';
26:   return 'ammo';
27: }
28: 
29: // Geometrias por categoria — uma única Mesh por pickup.
30: function buildGeometry(cat) {
31:   switch (cat) {
32:     case 'health': {
33:       // cruz verde: shape 2D extrudado
34:       const s = 0.34, t = 0.11, d = 0.1;
35:       const shape = new THREE.Shape();
36:       shape.moveTo(-t / 2, s / 2);
37:       shape.lineTo(t / 2, s / 2);
38:       shape.lineTo(t / 2, t / 2);
39:       shape.lineTo(s / 2, t / 2);
40:       shape.lineTo(s / 2, -t / 2);
41:       shape.lineTo(t / 2, -t / 2);
42:       shape.lineTo(t / 2, -s / 2);
43:       shape.lineTo(-t / 2, -s / 2);
44:       shape.lineTo(-t / 2, -t / 2);
45:       shape.lineTo(-s / 2, -t / 2);
46:       shape.lineTo(-s / 2, t / 2);
47:       shape.lineTo(-t / 2, t / 2);
48:       shape.closePath();
49:       return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, { depth: d, bevelEnabled: false });
50:     }
51:     case 'armor': {
52:       // escudo azul: placa hexagonal fina
53:       const w = 0.4, h = 0.46, d = 0.08;
54:       const shape = new THREE.Shape();
55:       shape.moveTo(-w / 2, -h / 2);
56:       shape.lineTo(-w / 2, 0);
57:       shape.quadraticCurveTo(-w / 2, h / 2, 0, h / 2);
58:       shape.quadraticCurveTo(w / 2, h / 2, w / 2, 0);
59:       shape.lineTo(w / 2, -h / 2);
60:       shape.lineTo(w * 0.35, -h / 2);
61:       shape.lineTo(0, -h / 2 + h * 0.22);
62:       shape.lineTo(-w * 0.35, -h / 2);
63:       shape.closePath();
64:       return new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(shape, { depth: d, bevelEnabled: false });
65:     }
66:     case 'ammo':
67:       return new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.26, 0.26, 0.26);
68:     case 'weapon':
69:     default:
70:       return new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.3, 0.16, 0.42);
71:   }
72: }
73: 
74: const CAT_COLORS = {
75:   health: 0x44ff66,
76:   armor: 0x44aaff,
77:   ammo: 0xffcc44,
78:   weapon: 0xff7733,
79: };
80: 
81: function buildMaterial(cat) {
82:   const color = CAT_COLORS[cat] ?? 0xffffff;
83:   return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
84:     color,
85:     emissive: color,
86:     emissiveIntensity: 1.4,
87:     roughness: 0.45,
88:     metalness: 0.15,
89:   });
90: }
91: 
92: export function createPickups(scene, map) {
93:   const list = map?.pickups ?? [];
94:   const pickups = [];
95:   for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
96:     const p = list[i];
97:     const cat = categoryOf(p.type);
98:     const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(buildGeometry(cat), buildMaterial(cat));
99:     mesh.position.set(p.x, BASE_Y, p.z);
100:     scene.add(mesh);
101:     pickups.push({
102:       ...p,
103:       id: i,
104:       cat,
105:       mesh,
106:       baseY: BASE_Y,
107:       phase: phaseFor(i),
108:     });
109:   }
110:   return pickups;
111: }
112: 
113: export function updatePickups(pickups, dt, playerX, playerZ, collectRadius, onPickup) {
114:   for (const p of pickups) {
115:     if (p.collected) continue;
116:     const t = (times.get(p) ?? 0) + dt;
117:     times.set(p, t);
118:     // bobbing suave + rotação lenta
119:     p.mesh.position.y = p.baseY + Math.sin(t * BOB_SPEED + p.phase) * BOB_AMPLITUDE;
120:     p.mesh.rotation.y += dt * SPIN_SPEED;
121:     const dx = p.mesh.position.x - playerX;
122:     const dz = p.mesh.position.z - playerZ;
123:     if (dx * dx + dz * dz < collectRadius * collectRadius) {
124:       if (typeof onPickup === 'function') onPickup(p);
125:       p.collected = true;
126:       p.mesh.parent?.remove(p.mesh);
127:       p.mesh.geometry.dispose();
128:       p.mesh.material.dispose();
129:     }
130:   }
131:   return pickups.filter((p) => !p.collected);
132: }

(End of file - total 132 lines)
</content>
